title: Heartbeat request 0.1
description: Request body for POST /v1/case-executions/{case_execution_id}/heartbeat. A heartbeat extends a still-valid lease while the adapter is working. It cannot resurrect a completed, canceled, or superseded lease; the orchestrator answers those with a conflict rather than a new expiry.

progress.description: Optional liveness detail. Deliberately non-semantic: it never carries agent output or observation values.
